prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Practice Chatting With Your Companion", "Type a message or press speech to test your pet's desktop response features right now.", "Try saying hello or typing a command to your pet.", "Test Chat Message"]
1: ["Signing in secures your companion data across restarts and devices."]
2: ["Practice Summoning & Hiding Your Pet", "Try pressing the shortcut key to toggle your desktop companion visibility.", "Practice Summon Shortcut"]
3: ["Verifying Account & Securing Companion", "Checking cloud authentication and restoring saved pet profiles..."]
4: ["Preparing Desktop Layer & Pet Rendering", "Verifying desktop window transparency, layering, and display bounds..."]
5: ["Set Companion Desktop Behavior", "Choose how active your pet should be while you work on your desktop.", "Behavior Mode", "Confirm Behavior Settings"]
6: ["Use clear, well-lit photos with your pet centered for best rendering quality."]
7: ["Your Desktop Companion is Ready!", "Review essential desktop controls and quick action shortcuts below.", "Quick Controls Ready", "Desktop Shortcuts Overview"]
8: ["Select standard companion for immediate setup or custom path to build your own pet."]
9: ["Verifying pet traits and generating official adoption seal..."]
